references.title: Choose a display size
references.content:
Supplier: Please choose a small or medium notice board.
Reader — sent: I will check the wall space.
Supplier: Thanks. We still need the size choice.
references.context: Entirely fictional teaching conversation, separate from the 50 test targets. The reader ordered a notice board and has not chosen its size.
references.label: act
references.distinction: Promising to decide is not the decision; the supplier is still waiting.

references.title: Display size confirmed
references.content:
Supplier: Please choose a small or medium notice board.
Reader — sent: Medium, please.
Supplier: Medium confirmed. No other changes.
references.context: Entirely fictional teaching conversation, separate from the 50 test targets. The size choice was sent and no further work is owed.
references.label: skip
references.distinction: A later sent reply settles the earlier request; a routine acknowledgment need not create another task.

references.title: A guide the reader requested
references.content: Reading desk: You asked about furniture joints. A loose joint can move because the glue bond has failed or the wood has changed shape. Inspect the fit before adding more material. No reply or exercise is required.
references.context: Entirely fictional teaching conversation, separate from the 50 test targets. The fictional reader requested practical furniture-repair reading.
references.label: read
references.distinction: Wanted reading can be worth seeing even without a task.

references.title: Optional promotional bundle
references.content: Offers desk: Buy a bundle of decorative stickers before the offer ends tonight. There is no existing order and no payment is due.
references.context: Entirely fictional teaching conversation, separate from the 50 test targets. The reader does not want decorative sticker promotions and has promised no reply.
references.label: skip
references.distinction: A promotional deadline does not create a reader obligation or useful information.

references.title: Waiting for the stand maker
references.content: Stand maker: We have your final specifications and will send the completed design on April 12. Nothing else is needed from you.
references.context: Entirely fictional teaching conversation, separate from the 50 test targets. It is April 8. The reader wants to know this newly confirmed delivery date, and no follow-up is due.
references.label: read
references.distinction: A useful update while someone else owns the next step is information, not a reader task.

references.title: Which finish should we use?
references.content:
Maker: Please approve the finish we discussed.
Reader — sent: I do not have the finish options. Can you send them?
Maker: Please choose the finish before we start.
references.context: Entirely fictional teaching conversation, separate from the 50 test targets. All available messages are present, but no finish options or prior agreement are available.
references.label: act
references.distinction: The reader owes a clarification, not an invented approval. Missing substantive detail must remain visible.
